spans.s: भय (I) n. 1. Fear, alarm, dread, fright, terror, पश्चार्धेन प्रविष्टः शरपतनभयाद्भूयसा पूर्वकायम् Sak.i., M.vi.31; 2. a danger, a risk, a hazard, यतश्च भयमाशंकेत्ततो विस्तारयेद्बलम् M.vii.188.
भय (II) m. Sickness, disease.
भय-आक्रांत a. overcome by fear.
भय-आतुर, -आर्त a. alarmed, frightened.
भय-आतुर, -आर्त a. alarmed, frightened.
भय-आवह a. 1. causing alarm; 2. dangerous, स्वधर्मे निधनं श्रेयः परधर्मो भयावहः Bg.iii.35.
भय-उत्तर a. attended with or succeeded by fear.
भयकर a. terrifying, fearful, dangerous.
भयकर a. terrifying, fearful, dangerous.
भय-डिंडिम m. a drum used in battle.
भय-द्रुत a. fleeing from fear, routed, put to flight.
भय-प्रतीकार m. removal of fears.
भय-प्रद a. terrible.
भय-प्रस्ताव m. an occasion of alarm.
भय-ब्राह्मण m. a timid Brāhmaṇa, who announces his caste to save himself.
भय-व्यूह m. a particular array of an army when threatened with danger from all sides.
भयानक (I) a. (f. का) Frightful, terrible, horrible, Bg.xi.27.
भयानक (II) n. Terror.
भयानक (III) m. 1. A tiger; 2. an epithet of Bahu; 3. one of the nine sentiments in poetry, the sentiment of terror. See K.Pr.iv. and अष्टरस under अष्टन्.
भयानक (I) a. (f. का) Frightful, terrible, horrible, Bg.xi.27.
